description: This file defines a class ContentFragment that extends Android's Fragment class, used to display dynamic content in a ViewPager. It includes methods for creating new instances with specific parameters and setting up the view with provided data.

classes.name: ContentFragment
classes.description: A fragment class that displays a title, indicator color, and divider color. It provides a factory method to instantiate with parameters and sets up the view with the provided data.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new ContentFragment with specified title, indicator color, and divider color, passing these as arguments in a bundle.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout resource R.layout.pager_item and returns the view.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views within the fragment and populates them with the arguments data such as title, indicator color, and divider color.
